topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: I just got a note from Mr. Henderson, the neighbor who moved in last year. He mentioned wanting to install a fence between our properties. It's not that I have anything against fences; in fact, it could be good for privacy. But the way he put it, almost like a formality, made me wonder if he's planning something more. I’ve been thinking about how to respond. Part of me wants to suggest we talk in person about it, maybe even share the cost or decide on the style together. But I’m also considering just letting him go ahead if that’s what he really wants. I suppose I’ll take some time to think it over and try to call him later.
